mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2% signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 6% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investor sentiment weakens amid labor market stress.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.6 percentage points in the next month
failure_condition: 20d returns remain positive despite UNRATE crossing above 6% threshold in the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDP (GDPC1) and household spending (HOUST) in the prior month predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, amplifying demand-driven equity valuation increases.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and HOUST increase in the prior month
failure_condition: 20d returns are negative despite both proxies rising in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, rising federal funds rates signal higher borrowing costs, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns remain positive during periods of FEDFUNDS increases above 2008-2009 average.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) for three consecutive months predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, reflecting stronger supply-side growth and investor optimism.
failure_condition: 5d returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO shows upward momentum for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in employment (PAYEMS) below 125,000 in the next month triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as weak labor demand signals economic contraction.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS falls below 125,000 in the next month
failure_condition: 20d returns remain positive despite PAYEMS dropping below 125,000.

mechanism_narrative: A confluence of rising GDP (GDPC1) and falling federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) in the prior month predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as demand expansion offsets tightening monetary policy.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises while FEDFUNDS falls in the prior month
failure_condition: 20d returns are negative despite both proxies moving in expected directions.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, rising business investment demand (RSAFS) signals stronger economic momentum, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as risk appetite increases.
failure_condition: 60d returns remain negative despite RSAFS showing upward momentum in the expansion phase.
